verdicts.quote: Error text identifies the relevant record when feasible without echoing submitted values.
verdicts.missing: The status codes distinguish broad failure types. The specification leaves open which failing rows to report and how to explain the cause for each.

verdicts.quote: 409 for an email conflict with the store or within the batch (case-insensitive).
Columns cannot supply privileges or IDs.
verdicts.missing: File-supplied roles are ruled out. The specification does not define the access assigned to a new user or bound it by the importer's authority.

verdicts.quote: accept POST /admin/users/import from an operator authorized with an Authorization Bearer value matching ADMIN_TOKEN.
verdicts.missing: The import credential is explicit. Its relationship to permission to create a single user is unspecified.

verdicts.quote: with exactly the name and email columns in either order. … 400 for invalid UTF-8, syntax, header or rows
optionally with a UTF-8 BOM, with exactly the name and email columns in either order. Accept LF or CRLF, optional trailing newline, comma and newline inside quoted fields, and doubled quotes.
An empty file or header-only file is invalid. … a subsequent valid Jane-only upload gets ID 4.
409 for an email conflict with the store or within the batch (case-insensitive). … Every rejection leaves state unchanged.
The store checks all identities and applies T-1. The response reports 201; a subsequent GET reads the result.
verdicts.missing: The HTTP response signals completion. The specification gives no background processing or later completion notification for large files.

verdicts.quote: stores names and emails in the same process memory exposed by the existing GET surface. The upload body is transient.
verdicts.missing: The storage location and disposal point for the CSV itself are unspecified, as is whether anyone can retrieve it again.

verdicts.where: Flows, F-1 and State and transitions, T-2
verdicts.quote: An interrupted request before body completion never commits. … Store and next ID unchanged; administrator can correct and retry
verdicts.missing: The specification leaves cancellation after upload and the handling of a retry containing only failed rows unspecified.

verdicts.quote: Same existing users plus the new rows, with consecutive IDs
verdicts.missing: The specification preserves existing users but gives no compatibility requirement for creating one user by hand.
